meta.title: Skills catalog
meta.description: Browse, filter, and install Openwisdom scenario skills and discipline references. Analysis runs in your agent, not on this site.

intro.title: Skills catalog
intro.lede: Discover official scenario workflows. Filter by layer, discipline, and provenance. Install into your own agent to run analysis.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap + multi-discipline curated
bootstrap.body: Three official scenarios are product seeds; others are curated-external GitHub SKILL.md entries tagged by psychology, sociology, history, political science, economics, and philosophy. Platforms like Xiaohongshu are only used when they cite verifiable open repos. Full skills/ tree and heat are not wired. Use discipline chips in the toolbar; search with Ctrl+K / ⌘K.

actions.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the command and copy manually.

detail.referencesNote: Linked items exist in the catalog; others are planned labels or upstream concept names.
detail.bodyPending: Full SKILL.md bodies land with the in-repo skills/ tree. This page shows structured metadata and workflow summary for evaluation and install.
detail.bodyExternal: Full body lives upstream. This page gives an honest summary, license, and install entry points — read SKILL.md on GitHub.
detail.author: Author
detail.githubTabBody: Browse SKILL.md upstream or in the monorepo path; clone and copy into your harness skills directory.
detail.manual1: Open the skill folder on GitHub or clone the repo.
detail.manual2: Place the skill folder in your agent skills path (e.g. .claude/skills/).
detail.manual3: Reload the agent and invoke per the skill docs.
detail.afterInstall: Analysis runs in your agent, not on this site. After install, call the skill in your harness.
